reason: Actual exact-source/master comparison: the source receding but visibly present short grey side hair and light grey eyebrow hair were erased, leaving a completely bald and browless mascot. Original open olive jacket, khaki shirt, darker tie, clean-shaven face, full photo backing/frame and overlapping note are retained. Collar fit is coherent and white/cyan/alpha views show no internal transparent holes. Missing visible scalp/eyebrow hair requires a separate built-in repair; a receding source hairline does not authorize removing the remaining side hair.
